bounded_observations: The binary has no recovered ReadArgs template; it is a startup preference service rather than a normal option command.
Embedded diagnostics cover iffparse, locale, diskfont, file, keymap, datatypes, font, sound and picture failures.
The Workbench member is non-PURE by its observed protection word.

startup_contract.duplicate_guard: FindTask(IPREFS_SEM_NAME) returns failure without starting a second service
startup_contract.process: CreateNewProcTags(IPREFS_SEM_NAME, priority 0, PPC code, no console/current/home directory, no copied variables)
startup_contract.completion: A private message port receives one completion message after preference loading; only then does main validate installation and return RETURN_OK.
startup_contract.environment: Expand ENV:, create missing ENV:sys and ENVARC:sys directories, and use the resolved environment root for the preference table.

runtime_services: IFF preference dispatch through the ID-based handler table
font, screen, palette, pointer and Workbench pattern loading
printer, serial, sound, network, Poseidon, powerbook, compositing and disk-cache preference handlers
notification setup and delayed Workbench screen reopen
installation/version validation with requester, reboot or shift-qualified shell fallback

evidence_limits: No profile has an original guest startup receipt, exact preference ordering/output, requester comparison or result/IoErr trace.
The MorphOS source is behavior evidence only and is not copied into CopperOS; its packed member has no recovered version tag.
The Workbench member's exact service sequence and preference file set are not inferred from the MorphOS source.
IPrefs owns a continuing process and global preference state, so resident/PURE, termination, concurrent startup and package gates remain open.
No implementation may fake preference success while required providers or a supported desktop service are absent.
